key_reasoning.reason: New script tool access editor in ToolTab/ToolForm, field registry, ToolConfiguration type, kind-aware warnings util (notifyAboutConsumerSlots), publish modal, validate caller (useWorkflowHistoryRestore), and Create/Edit pages.

No existing multi-alias per-tool list control (assistant IntegrationSelector is single-value). ToolTab save whitelist silently drops the new field. Closest pattern is the assistant IntegrationSelector, and it does not cover the multi-alias or duplicate-prevention case. ToolTab and ToolForm have no tests.
About 8-12 files modified across src/pages/workflows, src/utils, src/types and src/store, plus 1-3 new components, in 3+ directories.
